Elena (CFO): Quick follow-up to the all-hands finance Q&A — summarizing decisions and immediate actions.
Jon (CEO): thanks Elena. any changes that shift runway materially?
Elena (CFO): No immediate change. Forecast still ~21 months under base case. Biggest levers: unexpected Dedicated usage and large PS contracts slipping through approvals.
Maya (Procurement): New approval rules (effective now):
- <= $2k: employee + manager
- $2k-$20k: manager + Finance Ops
- > $20k: Director + Finance + Legal
Sam (SWE): So $25k -> $20k change confirmed?
Luca (Finance Ops): Correct. Threshold lowered to improve controls. Also: tag cost centers on all infra/vendor requests.
Aisha (Head of Ops): Emergency spend chain? Need something after hours.
Elena (CFO): Emergency: on-call eng -> on-call SRE -> Finance Ops on-call -> CFO. Post-facto review within 48 hrs.
Sam (SWE): Can Procurement publish a 1-pager for reserved GPUs (fields, who to CC)?
Maya (Procurement): Yes — will publish a playbook in Notion by EOD and create a reserved-gpu ticket template.
Luca (Finance Ops): Finance will publish a short FAQ tomorrow with examples (reserved GPU, PS contract).
Jon (CEO): Great — @channel when docs are live so managers can act.
Elena (CFO): Closing thread. DM me if you spot edge cases. :thumbsup:
